situation: Day 6 after a C-section: standing up from bed at 3 AM pulls and burns at the incision; discharge advice was generic.
promise: Move — stand, sit, rise — without bracing in anticipatory fear of pain.

current_behavior: holding furniture and waiting for pain to pass
emotional_state: fear that something is wrong internally

new_capabilities: position and rise without straining the incision

mechanism.core_mechanism: Module 2 — The 3-Position Recovery Method (positioning/support technique for lying→sitting→standing without straining the incision site)

evidence.claim: pilot cohort reported improved movement confidence by day 3-5

safety.scope_boundary: Everyday movement positioning ONLY. Never diagnoses; never replaces clinical care.
escalation_rules: any red flag = same-day medical care
safety.disclaimer: Educational content — not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice.

permitted_claims: you can reduce anticipatory bracing while rising
a specific rise technique may reduce strain
